title: 3‑BR 30A Vacation Home with Communal Pool and Beach Access
meta_description: Experience Making Memories, a 3-BR, 2.5-bath 30A vacation home in Gulf Mist subdivision with a communal pool and beach access. Accommodates 8 guests.
description_expanded: Making Memories is just 3 minutes to the sugar white sands and emerald waters of the 30A beaches. Located in the popular Gulf Mist subdivision, with this home you'll also have access to the beautiful community pool as well!The 1st floor of this home is the main living area with a spacious kitchen overlooking the beautiful dining area. Everything is light, bright, and beachy here. Out the back door is a gas grill and fire pit area with more seating for all of your outdoor gathering needs.All 3 bedrooms are upstairs to sleep 8 comfortably. The 2 guest bedrooms share a large hallway bathroom with dual sinks and tub/shower combination. All bedrooms have TVs as well as access to the balcony. Right off the master suite is a wonderful additional outdoor entertaining space with TV and mini fridge.At Making Memories, you'll enjoy a relaxing vacation with plenty of comfortable furnishings and wonderful outdoor living spaces.Sleeping Arrangements:2nd floor, Bedroom 1: Queen bed, TV and balcony access.2nd floor, Bedroom 2: Queen-over-queen bunk bed, TV and balcony access2nd floor, Bedroom 3: King bed, TV, and balcony access. Private bath with dual vanities and large shower.Beach Access:Heading out the subdivision, cross 30A and turn right onto the walking path. Take this down a few feet past The Palms to your beach access, Pelayo.Distance: .1 miles | Time: 3 minutes walkingGulf Mist:White picket fences adorn the well-kept lawns as you take a leisurely walk to this Seagrove Beach neighborhood pool. You will feel right at home in this cozy community of Gulf Mist beach cottages located directly across Scenic 30A from the beautiful beaches of South Walton. Make your way just down 30A to the beach access and you'll have your toes in the sand within minutes.Seagrove Beach:Named for the thick grove of oak trees lining its coastline, Seagrove Beach is located in the heart of 30A. The coastal villages of Seaside, Grayton, and WaterColor lie within a mile or two to the West, while Rosemary Beach, Alys Beach, and WaterSound lie a few miles East. There's no better spot to experience everything 30A has to offer!Your stay at Making Memories comes with Xplorie’s best activities! one ticket per day, per activity! (over $800 in nightly value) Tee off at Emerald Bay or Regatta Bay, zip through Baytowne Adventure Zone, and sail on the Sea Blaster Dolphin Cruise. Enjoy Big Kahuna’s Water Park, Black Light Mini Golf, and scenic bike rides with complimentary rentals. Explore 30A with ease and adventure!* Sorry, no pets allowed.* Parking for 2 cars.An initial Benchmark signature box of amenities is provided for all guests.?For the kitchen this includes: 1 roll of paper towels, 1 dish sponge, 1 dish soap, 2 dishwasher pods, 1 pack of kitchen wipes and liners for each trashcan plus 2 washing machine pods. For each bathroom it includes: 1 roll of toilet paper, 1 set of facial and bath soaps/body wash/shampoo/conditioner/lotion. For towels you will receive: 1 body towel/1 washcloth per guest and 2 hand towels per bathroom.
